{'Recently, Mophie has launched four new external chargers for iPhone. They can easily slip into your pocket, come in two design options, feature built-in cables, and offer 5,000mAh or 10,000mAh capacities. They are by no means the smallest chargers on the market, but the pricing is quite attractive and worth considering.': 'Mophie 最近推出了四款全新的 iPhone 外置充電器。產品可以輕鬆放入口袋，提供兩種設計選擇，配備內置充電線，並提供 5,000mAh 或 10,000mAh 容量。雖然它們絕對稱不上市面上最細小的充電器，但定價相當吸引，值得考慮。'}

{"Mophie's brand-new PowerStation Plus power banks are divided into Standard and Signature editions, each available in 5,000mAh and 10,000mAh capacity options.": 'Mophie 全新的 PowerStation Plus 流動電源分為標準版（Standard）及 Signature 版，每個版本均提供 5,000mAh 和 10,000mAh 容量選擇。'}

{'The Standard and Signature editions share the same dimensions, but the Signature edition features a more premium finish and comes with braided cables.': '標準版和 Signature 版尺寸相同，但 Signature 版採用更高級的工藝，並配備編織線。'}

{'All four versions have a built-in USB-C cable for charging your device in emergencies, but the cable is not retractable. The cable is located on the side of the power bank and can be pulled out when you need to charge.': '四個型號均內置一條 USB-C 充電線，以備不時之需，不過充電線並非可伸縮式設計。充電線設於流動電源的側面，需要充電時可以拉出使用。'}

{'The three lower-tier PowerStation Plus models come with one built-in cable, while the Signature 10K version has two braided cables. Combined with an additional USB-C port, you can charge up to three devices simultaneously.': '三款較低階的 PowerStation Plus 型號配備一條內置充電線，而 Signature 10K 版本則有兩條編織線。配合額外的 USB-C 接口，最多可以同時為三部裝置充電。'}

{"As mentioned at the start, these power banks are definitely not the smallest on the market, but they aren't as bulky as many other brands either. This allows them to fit easily into a trouser pocket without being too obtrusive, without needing to be carried in a backpack. It also features an LED charging status indicator.": '正如開首所述，這些流動電源絕對不是市面上最小的產品，但亦不及許多其他品牌般笨重。它們可以輕鬆放進褲袋而不會過於突兀，無需放入背包攜帶。產品亦配備 LED 充電狀態指示燈。'}

{'Each Mophie PowerStation Plus supports 20W output via the USB-C port. The same port can also be used to charge the power bank itself. The 5K version can fully charge an iPhone 17 Pro approximately once, while the 10K version can fully charge an iPhone 17 Pro twice. Given recent power bank fire incidents, Mophie has also designed these products to comply with airline carry-on luggage regulations.': '每款 Mophie PowerStation Plus 均透過 USB-C 接口支援 20W 輸出。同一接口亦可用作為流動電源本身充電。5K 版本可為 iPhone 17 Pro 完全充電約一次，而 10K 版本則可完全充電兩次。鑑於近期發生的流動電源起火事故，Mophie 亦將這些產品設計成符合航空公司手提行李的規定。'}

{'You can purchase the Mophie PowerStation Plus on Amazon, with the series priced from US$29.95 up to US$59.95.': 'Mophie PowerStation Plus 可於 Amazon 購買，全系列售價由 29.95 美元至 59.95 美元不等。'}

  • {'PowerStation Plus 5K Standard Series – US$29.95 on Amazon': 'PowerStation Plus 5K 標準版系列——Amazon 售價 29.95 美元'}
  • {'PowerStation Plus 10K Standard Series – US$39.95 on Amazon': 'PowerStation Plus 10K 標準版系列——Amazon 售價 39.95 美元'}
  • {'PowerStation Plus 5K Signature Series – US$39.95 on Amazon': 'PowerStation Plus 5K Signature 版系列——Amazon 售價 39.95 美元'}
  • {'PowerStation Plus 10K Signature Series – US$59.95 on Amazon': 'PowerStation Plus 10K Signature 版系列——Amazon 售價 59.95 美元'}

{'My recommended Apple accessories': '我推薦的 Apple 配件：'}

  • {'Anker Ultra-Slim MagSafe Power Bank': 'Anker Ultra-Slim MagSafe 流動電源'}
  • {'AirPods Pro 3 (Active noise cancellation twice as effective as AirPods Pro 2!)': 'AirPods Pro 3（主動降噪效果為 AirPods Pro 2 的兩倍！）'}
  • {'Anker Nano 45W Fast Charger with Smart Display': 'Anker Nano 45W 配備智能顯示屏快速充電器'}
  • {'Anker Prime 3-in-1 25W Compact MagSafe Charger': 'Anker Prime 3 合 1 25W 輕巧 MagSafe 充電器'}
  • {'Logitech MX Master 4 Mouse (Mac version)': 'Logitech MX Master 4 滑鼠（Mac 版本）'}
  • {'AirTag 2 four-pack (Precision Finding improved by 50%!)': 'AirTag 2 四件裝（精準尋找功能提升 50%！）'}
